prompt: Review the spacing and anchored-overlay change in evals/files/spacing-overlay-project. The project supplies its accepted current-build render report and ordered placement timeline under `evidence/`; do not launch another browser, replace its spacing tokens, or substitute another evidence policy. Identify the concrete grouping and overlay failures and report whether the change is complete.
expected_output: The review uses the rendered gap endpoints to distinguish the object and action groups, reports the reversed inter-group and intra-group hierarchy and the heading's separation from its own content, requires outside-click and focusable-Escape dismissal, reports the clipping and missing edge margin, and rejects the repeated flip as an unstable placement that must choose a side that fits.
assertions: Using the rendered gaps and project spacing tokens, the review distinguishes the object and action groups and reports both the inter-group gap smaller than an intra-group gap and the heading separated from its own content.
The review requires outside-click dismissal and Escape while the overlay is focusable, and reports that the fixture has only the outside-click path.
The review finds the overlay clipped at the supported viewport and rejects the missing edge margin and inaccessible action.
The review identifies the flip oscillation and requires flipping only into a side that fits, with no repeated back-and-forth.
